meta.note: x = world X (east), y = world north/Z, meters. Heights decoded from the level's HM2 block (Dagor CompressedHeightmap) - exact. Row 0 of the heightmap is at originY.

airfields.note: runway centrelines in replay-world-meters; headingDeg is the ends[0]->ends[1] bearing, take-off runs takeoffHeadingDeg; altM is absolute altitude, not height above ground
